notes: Alignment was by overlapping source position of anchors. All three documents were read against the source. Main disagreements: (1) modality for imperative items under Procedures or strategy lists (must vs should), resolved by the document's own wording; (2) unit_stance (restrict/require vs neutral/permit) for compliance duties and for conditions on permitted use, resolved by the codebook rule that conditions such as disclosure score permit and compliance or procedure duties score neutral; (3) actor/phase for institutional commitments, resolved by who acts; (4) policy_type for four pairs (BOV 1220 P56 vs P53 ethical use, P65 vs P50 AI approval process, P50 vs P62 research data entry; teaching P61 vs P04 opt-out, P59 vs P32 augment-not-replace; VHS P61 vs P44 role list), resolved by the passage wording. B coded the Hybrid and Permissive repeats of the same sentence and the Restrictive/Permissive violation repeats; four such exact repeats (B units 31, 32, 33, 37 of the teaching guidelines) were dropped under the codebook repeat rule. Other single-coder units were real policy sentences and were kept (A: 3, B: 4). Document stance disagreed only for the VHS page (permit vs delegates; resolved permit because the saved text delegates nothing). Both UNCOVERED units (partnerships, community engagement) were confirmed uncovered and no new types were added.
